verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for an LLM observability platform, but the evidence never says the LangSmith platform's source is published under an open license. The GitHub items cover only the client SDK (and an MCP server repo), which are adjacent artifacts rather than the product itself. Self-hosting is documented, but no license terms are given. Community items describe building open-source alternatives, which implies LangSmith itself is not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
